title: WaitLens: Temporal VLM-Based Adaptive Waiting for Industrial GUI Testing Agents
why: WaitLens VLM decides when industrial GUI-testing agents stop waiting after clicks via screenshot temporal windows.
mechanism: Lightweight VLM fine-tuned on GUI loading trajectories with temporal resampling; sliding-window screenshots predict Ready so agents end fixed waits early.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 86.08% ready-state accuracy vs 54.13% Qwen3-VL-2B backbone; Meituan industrial replay cuts mean post-ready wait 94.98% vs 20s fixed wait.

title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
why: PreView auxiliary model crops/zooms screenshots and adds visual/text cues before a frozen GUI grounding model clicks.
mechanism: Trainable preprocessor predicts/refines click center, builds local zoomed view plus red-circle visual cue and candidate textual description for a frozen grounding model.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: improves average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B/4B and OS-Atlas-4B on five-benchmark suite incl. ScreenSpot-Pro, OSWorld-G, MMBench-GUI L2 without training those grounders.
